news.title: Ajibade Apologises To Nigerians After Super Falcons Miss World Cup
news.lede: Super Falcons captain Rasheedat Ajibade has apologised to Nigerian football fans following the team’s failure to qualify for the FIFA Women’s World Cup, saying the players are determined to rebuild and return stronger. In a statement on X, Ajibade acknowledged the disappointment of missing the tournament for the first time…... In a statement on X, Ajibade acknowledged the disappointment of missing the tournament for the first time and said she personally took responsibility for the setback. There’s no way around that.

news.title: World Cup coach Graham Arnold returns to Baghdad - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq and the world
news.lede: Iraq football national team head coach Graham Arnold on Monday returned to Baghdad to finalize his contract extension and begin preparations for the Arabian Gulf Cup and 2027 AFC Asian Cup. The Australian had already accepted a deal running through February 20, 2027, with the possibility of a new agreement from March 1 covering Iraq’s 2030 World Cup qualifying campaign or finals participation. Arnold is expected to monitor Iraq Stars League matches as he assesses domestic players ahead of the 27th Arabian Gulf Cup in Jeddah from September 23 to October 6. Iraq are grouped with Saudi Arabia, Oman and Kuwait and will face the hosts in their final group match on September 29 before turning attention to the 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia.

news.title: Juventus signs Colombia defender Lucumi after impressive FIFA World Cup

(AP Photo/Jeff Roberson) Juventus said the 28-year-old centre-back had signed a four-year contract, and the fee paid to Serie A rival Bologna could rise above 22 million euros ($25.5 million) with performance bonuses. Turin Colombia defender Jhon Lucumí signed for Juventus on Monday for 19.5 million euros ($22.6 million) after impressing at the World Cup. Juventus said the 28-year-old centre-back had signed a four-year contract, and the fee paid to Serie A rival Bologna could rise above 22 million euros ($25.5 million) with performance bonuses.

news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: 'This is probably my last year'
news.lede: Cristiano Ronaldo is inching closer to retirement. "This is probably my last year of football, and I want to leave a spectacular legacy," Ronaldo, 41, told Vogue in an interview published on Sunday. Ronaldo, whose Al Nassr contract runs until June 2027, previously has stopped short of giving a timeline of when he'd be ready to call it a career. Ronaldo announced his retirement from World Cup play but did not close the door on making future appearances for the national team. .

news.title: Who will take helm of South Korean men’s national football team?
news.lede: South Korean players applaud their fans after the World Cup match against South Africa in June. SEOUL – Attention is turning to who will take the helm of the South Korean men’s national football team, as the country’s governing body prepares to name an interim coach ahead of a permanent appointment. The Korea Football Association has narrowed its search for an interim coach to three candidates – Gus Poyet, Jesus Casas and Domenec Torrent – according to local outlets on Aug 17. All three reportedly applied through the open recruitment process for the national team job, which closed on Aug 9.

news.title: How Coffee Planet turned football rivalries into The Great Football Roast
news.lede: Stories from the FIFA World Cup 2026 are still pouring through. This one shows how Coffee Planet brought a fresh twist to football fandom with The Great Football Roast, a real-time social campaign that celebrated one of the sport’s oldest traditions: fans roasting rival teams. Inspired by a simple observation that Coffee Planet roasts coffee while football fans roast each other, the campaign transformed every knockout fixture into a battle of witty, culturally rooted banter. As the tournament unfolded, Coffee Planet published a series of head-to-head football roasts, with fans of each nation taking playful digs at its opponent through football truths, cultural references and iconic stereotypes.

news.title: Rodri transfer news: Man City accept bid from Barcelona for World Cup-winning midfielder and former Ballon d'Or holder
news.lede: Rodri is set to undergo his Barcelona medical ahead of completing a £65.4m move from Manchester City. The Spain World Cup winner and former Ballon d'Or holder, who helped City to four Premier League titles and a Champions League triumph, is expected to sign a four-year contract. The 30-year-old had one year left on his contract and while Man City wanted him to stay and sign an extension, Barcelona's third offer proved to be too good to turn down. He has agreed a four-year deal with Barcelona.
